## Version history

- [V0.2.1](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/V0.2.1): Fix - winch slip reduced
- [V0.1.32](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/V0.1.30-35): Feature - Winches will now extend when pulled with enough force
- [V0.1.22](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/V0.1.21-22): Fix - Fixed winches not working properly after loading a saved game
- [V0.1.18](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/V0.1.17-18): Fix - winch cables are no longer too heavy to lift
- [V0.1.6](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/V0.1.6): Fix - ends of winches no longer float around in low gravity
